definitions.explanation: A stage of criminal proceedings in which a case is examined in open court before a judge, after an indictment has been filed. {公判|こうはん} refers specifically to the trial phase in which evidence is presented and testimony is heard, as opposed to the earlier investigation stage.

examples.japanese: {第一回|だいいっかい}{公判|こうはん}。
⟦{被告|ひこく}→被告：11080_hikoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{公判|こうはん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{起訴内容|きそないよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{否認|ひにん}した→否認する：22511_hininsuru⟧。
examples.english: The defendant denied the charges at the trial.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{公判|こうはん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{報道陣|ほうどうじん}→報道陣：30542_houdoujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{詰|つ}めかける→詰めかける：14192_tsumekakeru⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The trial for the case was held with many reporters crowding into the courtroom.

notes:
Composed of {公|こう} (public) and {判|はん} (to judge). The term refers to the open, public phase of a criminal trial, reflecting the principle that trials in Japan are generally held in public. It is a core term in crime reporting and legal writing, and is distinct from the earlier ⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧ (investigation) stage and from the formal ⟦{裁判|さいばん}→裁判：02773_saiban⟧ (court case) as a whole.

This word is a homophone of ⟦{広範|こうはん}→広範：12479_kouhan⟧ (wide-ranging) and ⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧ (second half). Context — courtroom, defendant, indictment — makes the meaning clear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {第一回|だいいっかい}{公判|こうはん}: the first hearing
- {公判|こうはん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: a hearing is held
- {公判|こうはん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{証言|しょうげん}→証言：11088_shougen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to testify in court
- {公判前|こうはんまえ}{整理手続|せいりてつづき}: pre-trial arrangement procedure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{裁判|さいばん}→裁判：02773_saiban⟧: trial, lawsuit — the general term for the whole process
- {審理|しんり}: (court) examination, hearing — the process of examining a case
- ⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧: verdict, judgment — the court's final decision
- ⟦{起訴|きそ}→起訴：10577_kiso⟧: indictment, prosecution — the step before {公判|こうはん} begins
